title: Uniform probability of an affine subspace
statement: Let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$ and let $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$. The probability that a uniformly chosen vector of $\mathbb F_2^n$ belongs to the affine subspace $a+H$ is the reciprocal of $2$ raised to the dimension of the subspace perpendicular to $H$ under the standard dot product.
hypotheses_covered: $H$ is a linear subspace of $\mathbb F_2^n$
